title: Global Equity Rotation Checkup
summary: Global rotation, fiscal persistence and contrasting entry outcomes.
assessment: The TSM-over-RTX switch and AMD and USB entries received strong support. Bitcoin’s six-month gain became a twelve-month loss and its proposed floor failed. Ulta’s earnings caution was partly right despite a rising stock. Fiscal skepticism was supported; the multi-year international and China theses remain open.

framework_lessons: A horizon range requires reporting both endpoints.
A correct earnings concern does not establish a correct stock sale.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
